2607.07258.title: FMMVCC: Fuzzy Mamba-based Multi-View Contrastive Clustering for Univariate Time Series
2607.07258.paper_summary: In many realistic scenarios, large volumes of time series data are generated with limited or expensive annotations. This limitation makes supervised learning methods difficult to apply and leads to the use of unsupervised approaches capable of discovering meaningful structures directly from raw data. Clustering therefore plays a crucial role in organizing time series into groups that share similar temporal patterns, enabling exploratory analysis and downstream tasks without requiring manual labeling. However, existing deep clustering methods often struggle to capture long-range temporal dependencies or rely on architectures with high computational cost. This paper introduces FMMVCC, a Mamba-based deep clustering framework for time series that leverages state space sequence modeling to efficiently learn temporal representations with linear complexity. Additionally, it utilizes multi-view self-supervised learning with temporal masking and augmentations. Experimental evaluation in 15 benchmark datasets proves that FMMVCC consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, achieving the best overall performance in 29 of 60 total metric evaluations and the highest average rank in all tested scenarios.
2607.07258.paper_summary_zh: 在許多現實情境中，大量的時間序列數據生成時伴隨著有限或昂貴的標註。這一限制使得監督學習方法難以應用，並導致使用無監督方法來直接從原始數據中發現有意義的結構。因此，聚類在將時間序列組織成共享相似時間模式的群組中扮演著至關重要的角色，使得探索性分析和下游任務得以進行，而無需手動標註。然而，現有的深度聚類方法往往難以捕捉長期的時間依賴性或依賴於計算成本高的架構。本文介紹了FMMVCC，一個基於Mamba的時間序列深度聚類框架，利用狀態空間序列建模以線性複雜度高效學習時間表示。此外，它還利用了帶有時間遮罩和增強的多視角自我監督學習。在15個基準數據集中的實驗評估證明，FMMVCC始終超越最先進的基準，在60個總指標評估中達到29個最佳整體性能，並在所有測試情境中獲得最高的平均排名。
